verdict.rationale: Shortcut ships its own MCP server that multiple agent tools (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex CLI) can connect to, and it positions the workspace as one place to track work from people and agents. That makes it a shared record agents and tools could hand work through, but the evidence never documents a handoff mechanism or any guarantee that context is preserved between tools or agents. Missing for 10: an explicit agent-to-agent or tool-to-tool handoff feature, documentation of context or state preservation across handoffs, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can hand off work between tools or agents without losing context or information
